title: MakazhanAlpamys/Soup: fine-tune a language model from one YAML file
friendlyTitle: Soup fine-tunes language models from one settings file
summary: Soup is a Python toolkit for fine-tuning language models from a single configuration file, including LoRA-style training and a layer-streaming mode the project says can train an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU. It was the second-highest new AI-related repository on today's trending list, with about 281 stars today and roughly 9,000 overall.
friendlySummary: Soup is an open-source tool for training a language model from a YAML file, including on smaller graphics cards. It gained about 281 stars today.
whyItMatters: Someone with a modest GPU can use it to adapt an open model to a private dataset without renting a large training cluster. The low-memory claim is the project's, backed by its own published measurements; verify it on your hardware before planning a production training run.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can try adapting an open model to your own data on a laptop GPU. Test the project's low-memory claim on your machine before you depend on it.
